description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nested Shambler, adding {C}{C}.
When Nested Shambler dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Nested Shambler trigger, creating at least three creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Nested Shambler from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
